designationHistory.designation: National Wildlife Refuge and Conservation Area
designationHistory.indexText: The Fish and Wildlife Service established the Kankakee National Wildlife Refuge and Conservation Area in Iroquois County, Illinois, by accepting a 66-acre donation from Friends of the Kankakee.

authority.citation: Administrative establishment by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (donation accepted; area first authorized in 2000 as Grand Kankakee Marsh NWR)

designationHistory.note: FWS sources disagree: the May 25, 2016 press release announces the establishment that day, while the 2022 Land Protection Plan says September 2016. No non-FWS source was read. The area was authorized in 2000 as Grand Kankakee Marsh National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: FWS press release, May 25, 2016: Kankakee National Wildlife Refuge and Conservation Area established in Illinois
FWS ServCat: Kankakee NWR and Conservation Area Land Protection Plan (2022): established September 2016
